mechanics: 500-Ki shared Awoken Skill. Current evidence establishes no direct attack-stat boost; its defining mechanic is automatic evasion that consumes Stamina, plus a unique counter behavior and replacement charged-attack options including Soaring Fist/Spirit Pulse. A maintained 2026 transformation guide records auto-dodge stamina consumption and reversion on stamina break, while Bandai Namco's October 2023 update confirms Ultra Instinct was added as an Awoken Skill. Exact dodge probabilities, per-action stamina cost, and mode-specific behavior remain version-sensitive.
evidence_boundary: Numerical values and community-observed behavior are source-reported observations. Exact frames, universal scaling, hidden interactions, and reward probabilities are not asserted without direct evidence.
